localeDecision.criterion: es, fr and de together drew 141 impressions and 2 clicks, against 953 for en and zh. Nobody maintains financial localisation for those three languages, so their figures go stale unnoticed -- the exact failure this batch of work exists to stop. Retiring them as a locale is one decision about three languages, not 141 decisions about individual URLs, so it is recorded as a rule rather than expanded into the url list.
localeDecision.rollback: Set locales to an empty array and rebuild. The pages are never deleted or redirected, so nothing else has to be restored.
